text:
maya: kicking off a short thread to lock the benchmark narrative for the launch + webinar. goal: show where user-facing slowdowns happen (tail) and how our serving levers drop the effective per-response spend. want something punchy and evidence-backed.

eli: +1. pivot idea: lead with a two-pane hero — left = latency needle (p50/p95/p99) for 3 real personas, right = effective $/response before vs after our optimizations.

sam: headline candidate: "Same model. Narrower tails. Lower per-response spend." then CTA to run a 2-min perf sandbox. want a clear percent up top (e.g., "up to 40% lower spend at p95 SLO").

camila: design guardrails: single hero PNG, 1200px min width, stackable for mobile (left panel becomes top). use max 3 color accents, minimal legend. include short alt text for thumbnails.

nina: sharing a tiny CSV excerpt from the perf artifact (us-west1, warmed kv, batching enabled):

```
persona,avg_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,cost_per_1k_raw,cost_per_1k_opt
customer-support,130,300,560,$12.8,$7.6
meeting-summarize,480,1040,1680,$34.0,$19.4
dev-assist,95,220,410,$14.6,$9.3
```

sam: perfect. let's also show a one-line waterfall beneath the bars listing where savings came from: batching, prefix cache hits, light quant + kernel tuning. each item 1 short bullet.

anna-brand: social options (short): A) "Keep user-visible slowness rare. Cut run costs. See how." B) "Measure tail latency, measure spend. Demo + webinar." both under 120 chars. will prep 2 headline variants (platform vs dev outreach).

ci-bot: perf-run/4945542 complete. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/perf/4945542 :white_check_mark:

maya: plan/owners: eli will pick final persona names + small table for the blog (EOD Tue), camila will build hero mocks (Wed AM), sam will write the waterfall + a 3-line methodology appendix (Wed PM), anna-brand will finalize social hooks and alt text (Thu). who can own the micro-demo sandbox?

camila: i'll own the mocks and export specs. will include a dark-mode variant.

eli: i'll own the persona table and tie numbers back to the artifact.

sam: i'll spin up the appendix and the waterfall copy. small ask: avoid heavy math in the hero; put the exact deltas in the appendix.

maya: love it. experiment idea: webinar reg poll "Priority today? Lower tail latency / Predictable throughput / Lower cost" to help route and surface sales signals. sam — can you wire the tags?

sam: yep, will tag leads by answer and pass high-intent ones to AE queue.

maya: final note: keep claims narrow and reproducible. label configs in the appendix and link to perf artifact. sync Fri 9am for preflight. :rocket:
